webResults.content: Cimarex Energy Declares Quarterly Cash Dividend Cimarex Energy Declares Quarterly Cash Dividend News provided by Cimarex Energy Co. Dec 06, 2018, 18:51 ET Share this article Share to DENVER, Dec. 6, 2018 /PRNewswire/ -- Cimarex Energy Co. (NYSE: XEC) announced today that its Board of Directors has declared a quarterly cash dividend on its common stock of $0.18 per share. The dividend is payable on March 1, 2019, to stockholders of record on February 15, 2019.
